name: worldbuilding-wiki
description: Hugo + Pagefind worldbuilding Wiki with portals, entity relations, backlinks, timeline generation, and GitHub Pages deployment.

scripts.quality:all: npm run wiki:validate && npm run quality:source && npm run quality:site
scripts.wiki:preview: node scripts/prepare-wiki.mjs --check --include-drafts && node scripts/prepare-wiki.mjs --include-drafts && hugo server -D
scripts.wiki:preview-search: node scripts/prepare-wiki.mjs --check --include-drafts && node scripts/prepare-wiki.mjs --include-drafts && hugo --buildDrafts --gc --minify && pagefind --site public --serve
scripts.wiki:build: npm run wiki:validate && npm run quality:source && npm run wiki:prepare && hugo --cleanDestinationDir --gc --minify && pagefind --site public && node scripts/verify-search-index.mjs && npm run quality:site
